queries.text: Why did the EU's AI Act enter into force in phases between 2024 and 2027, and what do the different deadlines require?
Number of distinct compliance deadlines specified in the EU AI Act Article 113, years
List of prohibited AI practices under Article 5 and their specific enforcement start date in August 2024, entities: European Union Member States
General applicability date for high-risk AI systems listed in Annex III versus those integrated into products under Annex I, dates: February 2026, August 2027
Scope of obligations for providers of general-purpose AI (GPAI) models regarding transparency and copyright policy, effective date: August 2025
Final deadline for full application of all remaining provisions not covered by earlier phases, date: August 2030

search_hits.title: The EU AI Act's phased entry into force (2024-2027)
search_hits.snippet: The EU AI Act — the world's first comprehensive AI law — entered into force 2024-08-01 with obligations phased through 2027.
